items.text: Ifuku deliliyi Mosi namanishi dehi kutuŋa tabanaka, nayiwayishi dehi manji, nayijiliki dehi niyuma yayu yejima, nikameŋa niyuma yakuyejima, nayiwayishi dehi manji, nayijiliki dehi;
atulamba twawaIsarela, wowu anyanta akumavumu awankakulula jawu, hiyakulambula nikulambula; diwu atulamba twanyichidi, diwu emeni nakutala owu achindiluwu.

Aleteli himulambu wawu kumesu aYehova, matemba akujika hewulu atanunadimu, naŋombi ikumi nayedi; atulamba ayedi itemba dimu, atulamba ayedi itemba dimu, kalamba wumu ŋombi wumu, kalamba wumu ŋombiwumu, chochu ho-o wejima wawu, ayishikiŋili kumesu atabanaka.
Yehova hakuhosha naMosi,
nindi, Tambulaku kulonda yiikali yakukoŋa nachu mudimu wetenti dakubulakena, wuyinki aLevi mwesekela nyidimu yawu.
Mosi watambwili nimatemba naŋombi, wayinkeli aLevi.
Matemba ayedi naŋombi awana wenkeh anyana kaGereshoni, mwomwesekelanyidimu yawu;
matemba awana naŋombi atanu nasatu wenkelianyana kaMerari, mwomwesekela nyidimu yawu, chakuyitalaŋa kudi Itamari mwana kakapristu Aroni.
Kwinza anyana kaKohati hayinkeluku, muloŋa wena diwu adiŋi akwamudimu wamalala, ayisendelaŋa hamafwiji awu.
Atulamba alambwili yakujilika nachu kameŋa ifuku dakawayishilu wumanji; epa, atulamba alambwili nyilambu yawu kumesu akameŋa.
Yehova hakumwila Mosi, nindi, Akalambulaŋa himulambu wawu, kalambanefuku dindi, kalamba nefuku dindi, kulonda kujilika nachu kameŋa.
Walambwih himulambu windi ifuku dakusambila, Nahashoni mwana kaAminadabi, wakumuchidi waYuda.

Mulambu windi, cheŋa chasilivachimu, kulema kwachu jishekeli nkulakaji namakumi asatu, chitasu chasiliva chimu, chajishekeli makumi atanu nayedi, mwomwesekela lushekeli lwakumalala, yejima yiyedi yenzala wuŋa walembuluka wakubomba namanji, wamulambu wawuŋa;
katuwa kawuru kamu kajisheke hikumi, kenzala insensi;
iyoŋa daŋombi weyala wumu, chizamba chamukoku wumu, mwana kamukoku wachizamba wumu wamwaka wumu, ahimulambu wakushita;
chizamba champembi wumu wamulambu wahanshidi;
niyimunayanyilambu yakuwunda, aŋombi ayedi, yizamba yanyikoku yitanu, yizamba yampembi yitanu, nyana kanyikoku yayizamba yamwaka wumuyitanu. Weniwu diwu himulambu waNahashoni mwana kaAminadabi.
Ifuku damu chiyedi Netaneli mwana kaZuwari, kalamba kaIsakari, walambwili.

Mulambu windi walambwiliyi, cheŋa chasiliva chimu, kulema kwachu jishekeli nkulakaji namakumi asatu, chitasu chasiliva chimu, chajishekeli makumi atanu nayedi, mwomwesekela lushekeli lwakumalala, yejima yiyedi yenzala wuŋa walembuluka wakubomba namanji, wamulambu wawuŋa;
nikatuwa kawuru kamu kajishekeli ikumi, kenzala insensi;
iyoŋa daŋombi weyala wumu, chizamba chamukoku wumu, mwana kamukoku wachizamba wumu wamwaka wumu, ahimulambu wakushita;
chizamba champembi wumu, wamulambu wahanshidi;
niyimunayanyilambu yakuwunda, aŋombi ayedi, yizamba yanyikoku yitanu, yizamba yampembi yitanu, nyana kanyikoku yayizamba yamwaka wumuyitanu. Weniwu diwu himulambu waNetaneli mwana kaZuwari.
Ifuku damu chisatu Eliyabi mwana kaHeloni, kalamba kawanyana kaZebuluni;

katuwa kawuru kamu kajishekeli ikumi, kenzala insensi;

Ifuku damu chiwana Elizuri mwana kaShedeyuri, kalamba kawanyana kaRubeni;

katuwakawuru kamu kajishekeli ikumi kenzala insensi;
iyoŋa daŋombi weyalawumu, chizamba chamukoku wumu, mwana kamukoku wachizamba wumuwamwaka wumu, ahimulambu wakushita;
chizamba champembi wumuwamulambu wahanshidi;

Ifuku damwikumi nakamu Paŋiyeli mwana kaOkirani, kalamba kawanyana kaAsheri;

katuwa kawuru kamu kajishekeli ikumi kenzala insensi;
iyoŋa daŋombi weyala wumu, chizamba chamukoku wumu, mwana kamukoku wachizambawumu wamwaka wumu, ahimulambu wakushita;

Ifuku dekumi nakayedi Ahira mwana kaEnani, kalamba kawanyana kaNafwatali;

himulambu windi cheŋa chasiliva chimu, kulema kwachujishekeli nkulakaji namakumi asatu, chitasu chasiliva chimu, chajishekeli makumi atanu nayedi, mwomwesekela lushekeli lwakumalala; yejima yiyedi yenzala wuŋa walembuluka wakubomba namanji, wamulambu wawuŋa;
katuwa kawuru kamuka jishekeli ikumikeni zalainisensi;
iyoŋa daŋombi weyala wumu, chizamba chamukoku wumu, mwana kamukoku wachizambawumu wamwaka wumu, ahimulambu wakushita;
chizamba champembiwumu wamulambu wahanshidi;
niyimuna yanyilambu yakuwunda, aŋombi ayedi, yizamba yanyikoku yitanu, yizamba yampembi yitanu, nyanakanyikoku yayizamba yamwaka wumu yitanu. Weniwu diwu himulambu waAhira mwana kaEnani.
Weniwu diwu himulambu wajilikiluwu nachu kameŋa kudi atulambatwa waIsarela ifuku dakawayishiluwu manji; yepa yasiliva ikumi nayiyedi, yitasu yasiliva ikumi nayiyedi, tutuwa twawuru ikumi natuyedi;

cheŋa chasiliva chimu kulema kwachu jishekeli nkulakaji namakumi asatu, yeŋa yejima chochu hohu, chitasu chimu makumi atanu nayedi, yitasu yejima chochu; siliva yayumiyi yejima yashi kili mujishekeli makombakaji ayedi namakulakaji awana, mwomwesekela lushekeli lwakumalala;
tutuwatwawuru ikumi natuyedi twenzala insensi twajishekeli ikumi, mwomwesekela lushekeli lwakumalala; wuru watutuwa itu twejima washi kili mujishe kelinkulakaji namakumi ayedi;

aŋombi amayala ahimulambu wakushita ejima ikumi nayedi, yizamba yanyikoku ikumi nayedi, nyana kanyiko kuyayizamba yamwaka wumu ikumi nayiyedi, nihimulambu wayu wawupa; nayizamba yampembi jahimulambu wahanshidi, ikumi nayiyedi;

niyimuna yanyilambu yakuwunda, aŋombi amayala ejima makumi ayedi nawana, yizamba yanyikoku makumi atanu nadimu, yizamba yampembi makumi atanu nadimu, nyana kanyikoku yayizamba yamwaka wumu makumi atanunadimu. Weniwu diwu himulambu wajilikiluwu nachu kameŋa helili anakawayishi dehi.

Cheŋililiyi Mosi nakuhosha nindi mwitenti dakubulakena, hakutiya Izu hidikuhosha nindi, didi nakufuma hetanda daluwi dekala hachimbaŋu chawunsahu, didi nakufuma hakachi kawakerubi ayedi; hakuhoshana yena.
